verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a hosted equity-management SaaS. Open-source availability is a fair question for this kind of product, since open-source cap-table tools exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open license; the docs cover only platform features such as cap tables, data rooms and 409A valuations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
